facts.text: Jolene mentioned playing Overcooked 2 with her partner, often for bets, and once won three large pizzas.

evidence.quote: Oh, I forgot to mention Overcooked 2 - this is a good co-op game if you're into hilarious and chaotic cooking. My partner and I often play for bets! I once won three large pizzas!

facts.text: Deborah recalled playing video games with her husband, which she described as a way to bond and make memories.

evidence.quote: Reminds me of when I used to play games with my husband. We'd take turns and it was a great way to bond and make memories.

facts.text: Jolene agreed with Deborah's statement about gaming bringing people closer and asked for Deborah's favorite game to play with her husband.

evidence.quote: Yeah, you're right! What's your favorite game to play with that person?
